dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate posterior margin defined by a concave spline with several distinct irregularities representing notch morphology along the upper third of the edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute morphology with a small radius of curvature at the terminal point, exhibiting a distinct posterior-leaning peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate convex curvature with an approximate 45-degree inclination relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of the observed horizontal base chord to the maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of at least four distinct mechanical notches/nicks on the superior trailing edge; scattered depigmented linear scratches visible on the lateral surface of the fin and adjacent dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic serrated or saw-tooth pattern on the upper posterior margin due to multiple contiguous notch anomalies.
